No alternative horizons, robustness samples, or later models are included.

Table 2 likelihood-ratio market-efficiency tests are retained as auxiliary contrasts on the existing returns-equation set. Table 1 Panel C decile summaries are included for current-year EARN and BKLG; no decile N is inferred.
